Choose exactly one bucket for the patient message:
1. SELF_CARE
2. ASYNC_PHYSICIAN

messages.content: I need a refill of the sleep medicine my clinician has prescribed for the past year. My dose and symptoms are unchanged, I have no new symptoms, and I have three tablets left. Can someone review the refill?
